title: Simple Changes Farm;Simple Changes Therapeutic Riding Center
specs: Operates a farm with a herd of horses including Quarter Horses, Arab/Andalusian crosses, draft crosses, and Thoroughbreds
Provides equine assisted services to individuals with disabilities to help them grow stronger physically and gain independence
Be at least 14 years old to volunteer
Ability to follow directions of program staff and/or instructors at all times
Be able to do chores independently, with little to no supervision, once trained
Ability to communicate diplomatically with others
Be able to commit to a weekly three-to-four-hour time slot for at least three months
Ability to walk briskly, jog short distances, and assist riders for three, 45-minute lessons
blurb: Simple Changes offers therapeutic riding and equine assisted activities for individuals with disabilities. They operate at a farm in Mason Neck, VA, providing a safe and supportive environment. The center is gender inclusive and welcomes all genders.
extraNote: Volunteering at Simple Changes is at the sole discretion of Simple Changes · No smoking, alcohol or drug use at Simple Changes Farm · Simple Changes Farm is a private facility; individuals only allowed on premises when authorized by staff
